high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "lindsaymariebrewer," who posted it 17 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The person on the left appears to be wearing a dark blue shirt and sunglasses, while the person on the right has long blonde hair and is dressed in a light-colored, sleeveless top.
